intro: Guwahati's five zones run along the Brahmaputra and south towards the Meghalaya border. The Old City and Riverfront around Pan Bazar and Paltan Bazaar is the easiest to reach by train or bus; Chandmari and Zoo Road mix older houses, builder floors and flats rented by students and small families; GS Road and Dispur grew around the capital complex and are mostly apartment buildings; Beltola and Khanapara add large complexes and quieter lanes in the far south; and Maligaon, Jalukbari and North Guwahati form the western corridor and the north bank. Office hours around Dispur, evening coaching on Zoo Road and the river crossings shape a tutor's timetable.

For years Assam's Class 10 examination was run by SEBA, the Board of Secondary Education, Assam, and the higher secondary course in Classes 11 and 12 by AHSEC, the Assam Higher Secondary Education Council. The state has since brought the two together under a single state school education board, so notices may carry the new name. A state board student needs a tutor who works from the prescribed textbooks and knows the medium of instruction the school uses. Families also follow CBSE and CISCE's ICSE and ISC, and class and board are matched together for every request.

Home and online lessons both have a place. A request from Hatigaon goes first to tutors in Hatigaon, then the rest of the GS Road and Dispur zone, then the city, then online, and the family is shown two or three tutors with fees before a free first demo; switching later costs them nothing. On the north bank, homes are spread out and tutors from the same side matter most. Bohag Bihu, Durga Puja and market days are sensible times to move a week's lesson online, and online tutors from across India can cover ICSE literature or specialist papers.

zone_notes.Old City & Riverfront: Guwahati railway station and the state bus terminal are in Paltan Bazaar, so tutors from across the city can arrive by train or bus, which makes this the easiest zone to reach. Many homes sit above or behind shop frontages, so a lane landmark and floor number matter, and the market streets are crowded through the working day.
zone_notes.Chandmari & Zoo Road: Evening coaching batches fill the roads and students' calendars here, so a fixed weekday slot that does not clash with coaching is what keeps lessons regular. Lanes in Lachit Nagar and Chandmari are narrow for parking, and apartment buildings on Zoo Road often keep a visitor register.
zone_notes.GS Road & Dispur: Buses from every direction pass through Ganeshguri, widening the pool of tutors who can reach this zone, and most families live in apartment buildings with two- and three-bedroom flats. Government office hours around the capital complex and the evening rush on GS Road are the two windows to avoid.
zone_notes.Beltola & Khanapara: Most tutors arrive by city bus or auto along GS Road or the highway, with Narangi station an option for the Six Mile side. Large complexes in Basistha and Khanapara need the tower, flat and gate in advance, and lessons near Beltola Bazar are easier away from its twice-weekly market days.
zone_notes.Maligaon, Jalukbari & North Guwahati: Kamakhya Junction in Maligaon and the bus depot at Adabari are the arrival points on the south bank, where apartment gates are common. North Guwahati, across the river and still being absorbed into the city, has spread-out houses and plots, so tutors who already live on the north bank are the practical choice.

boards: Guwahati tutors teach Assam state board students, CBSE students and ICSE and ISC candidates. For state board work, take the syllabus, timetable and paper pattern only from the board's official notices, keeping in mind that the older SEBA and AHSEC names have been merged into a single state school education board. CBSE sample papers and marking schemes are on the CBSE academic site, and ICSE and ISC regulations on the CISCE site. State your medium of instruction on your profile, since it matters to state board families.
faqs: How do Guwahati families' requests reach tutors?

Each family sends one request with the class, board, subjects, locality and times. NXTutors shortlists two or three tutors, looking in that locality first, then its zone, then elsewhere in Guwahati, then online. If you teach the right board and medium and live nearby, you are among the tutors the family compares before booking a demo.
Is it possible to teach online from Guwahati?

Yes. You can visit homes near you and teach online students anywhere in Assam or India. For home requests, local tutors are shown first; for online requests, location does not decide the match, so a tutor in Beltola can teach a student on the north bank, in another district or in another state.
Which parts of Guwahati should I offer?

Offer the side of the city you live on and any zone you can reach without crossing it at office hours. A tutor near Ganeshguri can cover much of GS Road and Dispur, while one in North Guwahati is valuable to families on the north bank. Mention bus or rail access on your profile if you rely on it.
How does the ID check for tutors work?

Tutors who join go through an ID check. A one-time code confirms your phone or email, and you upload a government photo ID that the team reviews before your profile goes live; real tutors who pass carry a Verified badge. The check covers identity, not background, and /how-we-verify-tutors has the full steps.
Where can I read about tutor plans?

The plans for tutors, and what each includes, are on /pricing. Lesson fees are separate: you decide your own, families see it before the free first demo, and a family that later prefers another tutor can switch at no cost. Read the plan details there before you sign up, so you know what you are choosing.
